# Load data
```{r load-data}
Population <- raster("Input/global_pop_2026_CN_1km_R2025A_UA_v1.tif")

Covariates <- stack("Input/Covariates3.tiff") 
names(Covariates) <- c("Population", "Malaria", "Urbanization", "Consanguinity", "EFI", "RDI", "Counselling", "Prevention")

Data8 <- read.xlsx("Output/Dataset 8.xlsx") %>%
         dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("Population", "Malaria", "Urbanization", "Consanguinity", "EFI", "RDI", "Counselling", "Prevention"))) %>%
         filter(!(ADM0 %in% c("Liberia", "Vanuatu")))

Datasets2 <- list('Dataset 8'  = Data8)

gpkg_dir <- "Input"

ADM0_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM0.gpkg")
ADM1_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM1.gpkg")
ADM2_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM2.gpkg")

ADM0_shapes <- st_read(ADM0_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geom) %>%
               rename(geo0 = geom)

ADM1_shapes <- st_read(ADM1_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geo_admin1, geom) %>%
               rename(geo1 = geom)

ADM2_shapes <- st_read(ADM2_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geo_admin2, geom) %>%
               rename(geo2 = geom)

ADM0_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM0_shapes, sf::st_crs(Covariates))
ADM1_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM1_shapes, sf::st_crs(Covariates))
ADM2_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM2_shapes, sf::st_crs(Covariates))


addSF <- function(Data) {st_as_sf(Data,
                                  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                                  crs = crs(Population),
                                  remove = FALSE)}

Datasets2 <- lapply(Datasets2, addSF)

rm(Data8, gpkg_dir, ADM0_gpkg, ADM1_gpkg, ADM2_gpkg, addSF)
```

```{r fig specs}
journal_save <- function(filename, plot, width_mm, height_mm, dpi = 300) {filename <- file.path(dirname(filename), paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename)), ".tiff"))

                                                                          if (!dir.exists(dirname(filename))) {dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)}

                                                                          tryCatch({ggplot2::ggsave(filename = filename,
                                                                                          plot = plot,
                                                                                          width = width_mm,
                                                                                          height = height_mm,
                                                                                          units = "mm",
                                                                                          dpi = dpi,
                                                                                          device = "tiff",
                                                                                          bg = "white",
                                                                                          compression = "lzw",
                                                                                          limitsize = FALSE)},
                                                                                   finally = {grDevices::graphics.off()
                                                                                              gc()})
                                                                          
                                                                          invisible(filename)}

save_leaflet_html <- function(widget,
                              file,
                              selfcontained = FALSE,
                              width_px = 1500,
                              height_px = 750) {if (!dir.exists(dirname(file))) {dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)}
  
                                                htmlwidgets::saveWidget(widget = widget, file = file, selfcontained = selfcontained)
                                                
                                                html_txt <- readLines(file, warn = FALSE)
                                                
                                                leaflet_css <- paste0("<style>",
                                                                      "html, body {",
                                                                      "  margin: 0 !important;",
                                                                      "  padding: 0 !important;",
                                                                      "  width: ", width_px, "px !important;",
                                                                      "  height: ", height_px, "px !important;",
                                                                      "  background: white !important;",
                                                                      "  overflow: hidden !important;",
                                                                      "}",
                                                                      ".leaflet, .leaflet-container, .html-widget {",
                                                                      "  width: ", width_px, "px !important;",
                                                                      "  height: ", height_px, "px !important;",
                                                                      "}",
                                                                      ".leaflet-container,",
                                                                      ".leaflet-container * {",
                                                                      "  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif !important;",
                                                                      "  font-size: 10pt !important;",
                                                                      "  color: black;",
                                                                      "  font-weight: normal !important;",
                                                                      "}",
                                                                      ".leaflet-control,",
                                                                      ".leaflet-control * {",
                                                                      "  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif !important;",
                                                                      "  font-size: 10pt !important;",
                                                                      "  color: black !important;",
                                                                      "  font-weight: normal !important;",
                                                                      "}",
                                                                      ".leaflet-popup-content,",
                                                                      ".leaflet-popup-content * {",
                                                                      "  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif !important;",
                                                                      "  font-size: 10pt !important;",
                                                                      "}",
                                                                      ".leaflet-tooltip,",
                                                                      ".leaflet-tooltip * {",
                                                                      "  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif !important;",
                                                                      "  font-size: 10pt !important;",
                                                                      "}",
                                                                      ".legend-title,",
                                                                      ".legend-title * {",
                                                                      "  font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif !important;",
                                                                      "  font-size: 10pt !important;",
                                                                      "  font-weight: bold !important;",
                                                                      "  color: black !important;",
                                                                      "}",
                                                                      "<Inputstyle>")
                                                
                                                if (any(grepl("<Inputhead>", html_txt, fixed = TRUE))) {html_txt <- gsub("<Inputhead>", paste0(leaflet_css, "<Inputhead>"), html_txt, fixed = TRUE)} 
                                                else {html_txt <- gsub("<body>", paste0("<body>", leaflet_css), html_txt, fixed = TRUE)}
                                                
                                                writeLines(html_txt, file)
                                                invisible(file)}

export_leaflet_tiff <- function(widget,
                                output_file,
                                width_px = 1500,
                                height_px = 750,
                                selfcontained = TRUE,
                                dpi = 300) {if (!dir.exists(dirname(output_file))) {dir.create(dirname(output_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)}
  
                                                                                    html_file <- sub("\\.tiff$", ".html", output_file)
                                                                                    png_file  <- sub("\\.tiff$", ".png", output_file)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    save_leaflet_html(widget = widget,
                                                                                                      file = html_file,
                                                                                                      selfcontained = selfcontained,
                                                                                                      width_px = width_px,
                                                                                                      height_px = height_px)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    html_txt <- readLines(html_file, warn = FALSE)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    html_txt <- gsub("<body>",
                                                                                                     paste0('<body style="margin:0; padding:0; background:white; overflow:hidden;">',
                                                                                                            '<style>',
                                                                                                            'html, body {',
                                                                                                            '  margin: 0 !important;',
                                                                                                            '  padding: 0 !important;',
                                                                                                            '  width: ', width_px, 'px !important;',
                                                                                                            '  height: ', height_px, 'px !important;',
                                                                                                            '  background: white !important;',
                                                                                                            '  overflow: hidden !important;',
                                                                                                            '}',
                                                                                                            '.leaflet, .leaflet-container, .html-widget {',
                                                                                                            '  width: ', width_px, 'px !important;',
                                                                                                            '  height: ', height_px, 'px !important;',
                                                                                                            '}',
                                                                                                            '<Inputstyle>'),
                                                                                                     html_txt,
                                                                                                     fixed = TRUE)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    writeLines(html_txt, html_file)
                                                                                    
                                                                                    webshot2::webshot(url = html_file,
                                                                                                      file = png_file,
                                                                                                      vwidth = width_px,
                                                                                                      vheight = height_px,
                                                                                                      zoom = 1,              
                                                                                                      cliprect = c(0, 0, width_px, height_px))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    magick::image_read(png_file) %>%
                                                                                    magick::image_write(path = output_file,
                                                                                                        format = "tiff",
                                                                                                        compression = "lzw",
                                                                                                        density = paste0(dpi, "x", dpi))
                                                                                    
                                                                                    file.remove(png_file)
                                                                                    invisible(output_file)}

make_horizontal_colourbar_legend <- function(pal,
                                             values,
                                             title = "",
                                             n_ticks = 6,
                                             width_px = 420,
                                             bar_height_px = 10,
                                             tick_height_px = 6,
                                             show_text = TRUE,
                                             accuracy = 0.01,
                                             comma_labels = FALSE,
                                             label_gap_px = 8,
                                             font_size_pt = 10) {values <- as.numeric(values)
                                                                 values <- values[is.finite(values)]
                                                                 
                                                                 if (length(values) == 0) {stop("No finite values supplied to make_horizontal_colourbar_legend().")}
                                                                 
                                                                 value_range <- range(values, na.rm = TRUE)
                                                                 
                                                                 if (diff(value_range) == 0) {value_range <- value_range + c(-0.5, 0.5)}
                                                                 
                                                                 legend_breaks <- pretty(value_range, n = n_ticks)
                                                                 legend_breaks <- legend_breaks[legend_breaks >= value_range[1] & legend_breaks <= value_range[2]]
                                                                 legend_breaks <- sort(unique(c(value_range[1], legend_breaks, value_range[2])))
                                                                 
                                                                 gradient_values <- seq(value_range[1], value_range[2], length.out = 100)
                                                                 colours <- pal(gradient_values)
                                                                 colour_stops <- paste0(colours, " ", seq(0, 100, length.out = length(colours)), "%")
                                                                 
                                                                 tick_positions <- scales::rescale(legend_breaks, to = c(0, 100), from = value_range)
                                                                 tick_positions <- pmax(0, pmin(100, tick_positions))
                                                                 
                                                                 if (comma_labels) {label_text <- scales::comma(legend_breaks, accuracy = accuracy)}
                                                                 else {label_text <- scales::number(legend_breaks, accuracy = accuracy)}
                                                                 
                                                                 inner_width_px <- width_px - 24
                                                                 tick_positions_px <- tick_positions Input 100 * inner_width_px
                                                                 keep_label <- rep(TRUE, length(label_text))
                                                                 
                                                                 estimate_label_width_px <- function(x) {nchar(x, type = "width") * font_size_pt * 0.55}
                                                                 
                                                                 label_width_px <- estimate_label_width_px(label_text)
                                                                 if (length(label_text) > 2) {for (i in 2:(length(label_text) - 1)) {previous_visible <- max(which(keep_label[seq_len(i - 1)]))
                                                                                                                                     previous_right <- tick_positions_px[previous_visible] + label_width_px[previous_visible] Input 2
                                                                                                                                     current_left <- tick_positions_px[i] - label_width_px[i] Input 2
                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                     if (current_left < previous_right + label_gap_px) {keep_label[i] <- FALSE}}
                                                                   
                                                                visible_before_max <- which(keep_label & seq_along(keep_label) < length(keep_label))
                                                                
                                                                if (length(visible_before_max) > 0) {last_before_max <- max(visible_before_max)
                                                                                                     max_i <- length(label_text)
                                                                                                     last_right <- tick_positions_px[last_before_max] + label_width_px[last_before_max] Input 2
                                                                                                     max_left <- tick_positions_px[max_i] - label_width_px[max_i] Input 2
                                                                                                     
                                                                                                     if (last_right > max_left - label_gap_px) {keep_label[last_before_max] <- FALSE}}}
                                                                 
                                                                 keep_label[1] <- TRUE
                                                                 keep_label[length(keep_label)] <- TRUE
                                                                 label_text[!keep_label] <- ""
                                                                 
                                                                 visible_ticks <- show_text & nzchar(label_text)
                                                                 ticks <- paste0('<div style="
                                                                                  position:absolute;
                                                                                  left:', tick_positions[visible_ticks], '%;
                                                                                  top:', bar_height_px, 'px;
                                                                                  width:0;
                                                                                  height:', tick_height_px, 'px;
                                                                                  border-left:1px solid black;
                                                                                  transform:translateX(-0.5px);
                                                                                 "><Inputdiv>',
                                                                                 collapse = "")
                                                                 
                                                                 labels <- if (show_text) {paste0('<div style="
                                                                                                   position:absolute;
                                                                                                   left:', tick_positions[visible_ticks], '%;
                                                                                                   top:', bar_height_px + tick_height_px + 2, 'px;
                                                                                                   transform:translateX(-50%);
                                                                                                   font-family:\'Times New Roman\', Times, serif !important;
                                                                                                   font-size:', font_size_pt, 'pt !important;
                                                                                                   font-weight:normal !important;
                                                                                                   color:black !important;
                                                                                                   white-space:nowrap;
                                                                                                  ">',
                                                                                                  label_text[visible_ticks],
                                                                                                  '<Inputdiv>',
                                                                                                  collapse = "")} 
                                                                           else {""}
                                                                 
                                                                 title_html <- if (show_text && nzchar(title)) {paste0('<div class="legend-title" style="
                                                                                                                        text-align:center;
                                                                                                                        font-family:\'Times New Roman\', Times, serif !important;
                                                                                                                        font-size:', font_size_pt, 'pt !important;
                                                                                                                        font-weight:bold !important;
                                                                                                                        color:black !important;
                                                                                                                        margin-bottom:5px;
                                                                                                                       ">',
                                                                                                                       title,
                                                                                                                       '<Inputdiv>')} 
                                                                               else {""}
                                                                 
                                                                 extra_height <- if (show_text) 18 else 4
                                                                 bottom_padding <- if (show_text) 24 else 10
                                                                 
                                                                 htmltools::HTML(paste0('<div style="
                                                                                        background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
                                                                                        padding:7px 12px ', bottom_padding, 'px 12px;
                                                                                        border-radius:4px;
                                                                                        width:', width_px, 'px;
                                                                                        font-family:\'Times New Roman\', Times, serif !important;
                                                                                        font-size:', font_size_pt, 'pt !important;
                                                                                        font-weight:normal !important;
                                                                                        color:black !important;
                                                                                        ">
                                                                                        ', title_html, '
                                                                                        <div style="
                                                                                        position:relative;
                                                                                        width:', inner_width_px, 'px;
                                                                                        height:', bar_height_px + tick_height_px + extra_height, 'px;
                                                                                        margin:0 auto;
                                                                                        ">
                                                                                        <div style="
                                                                                        position:absolute;
                                                                                        left:0;
                                                                                        top:0;
                                                                                        width:100%;
                                                                                        height:', bar_height_px, 'px;
                                                                                        background:linear-gradient(to right, ', paste(colour_stops, collapse = ", "), ');
                                                                                        "><Inputdiv>',
                                                                                        ticks,
                                                                                        labels,
                                                                                        '<Inputdiv>
                                                                                        <Inputdiv>'))}

make_raster_leaflet_map <- function(raster_layer,
                                    pal,
                                    domain,
                                    title = "",
                                    show_text = TRUE,
                                    opacity = 0.8,
                                    legend_position = "bottomleft",
                                    provider = "CartoDB.Positron",
                                    comma_labels = FALSE,
                                    accuracy = 0.01) {raster_values <- terra::values(raster_layer)
                                                      raster_values <- raster_values[is.finite(raster_values)]
                                                      
                                                      legend_html <- make_horizontal_colourbar_legend(pal = pal,
                                                                                                      values = raster_values,
                                                                                                      title = title,
                                                                                                      show_text = show_text,
                                                                                                      accuracy = accuracy,
                                                                                                      comma_labels = comma_labels)
                                                      
                                                      leaflet::leaflet(width = 1500,
                                                                       height = 750,
                                                                       options = leaflet::leafletOptions(minZoom = 2,
                                                                                                         worldCopyJump = FALSE)) %>%
                                                      leaflet::addProviderTiles(provider,
                                                                                options = leaflet::providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
                                                      leaflet::addScaleBar(position = c("bottomleft")) %>%
                                                      leaflet::setView(lng = 70, lat = 30, zoom = 4) %>%
                                                      leaflet::addRasterImage(raster_layer,
                                                                              colors = pal,
                                                                              opacity = opacity) %>%
                                                      leaflet::addPolygons(data = domain,
                                                                           color = "black",
                                                                           weight = 1.5,
                                                                           smoothFactor = 1,
                                                                           fillColor = "transparent",
                                                                           opacity = 1) %>%
                                                      leaflet::addControl(html = legend_html,
                                                                          position = legend_position)}

journal_theme <- function(base_size = 10, base_family = "Times New Roman") {ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
                                                                            ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
                                                                                           plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           strip.placement = "outside",
                                                                                           strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black", lineheight = 0.9, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 4)),
                                                                                           strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black", lineheight = 0.9),
                                                                                           panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
                                                                                           legend.position = "bottom",
                                                                                           legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 8, 8, 8))}


journal_theme_no_text <- function() {ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    axis.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
                                                    axis.ticks.length = unit(1.2, "mm"),
```

# Function for spatial density clustering
```{r geonoise}
geonoise <- function(df,
                     dataset_name = NULL,
                     k = 2,
                     epsilon_quantile = 0.95,
                     epsilon_upper_quantile = 0.98,
                     extent_fraction = 0.02,
                     minPts_multiplier = 0.75,
                     minPts_floor = 4,
                     output_dir = "OutputInputClusterInput",
                     export_plots = TRUE) {if (is.null(dataset_name)) {dataset_name <- deparse(substitute(df))}
  
                                           df_name <- paste(dataset_name, collapse = "")
                                           df_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", df_name)
                                           
                                           # Obtain coordinates
                                           if (!inherits(df, "sf")) {df <- sf::st_as_sf(df, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)}
                                           else {df <- sf::st_transform(df, 4326)}
                                           
                                           if (nrow(df) < 3) {df$geographic_isolate_removed <- FALSE
                                                              df$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                              df$dbscan_noise_removed <- FALSE
                                                              return(df)}
                                           
                                           coords <- sf::st_coordinates(df)
                                           valid_coord_rows <- stats::complete.cases(coords)
                                           df_geo_clean <- df[valid_coord_rows, ]
                                           
                                           if (nrow(df_geo_clean) < 5) {df_geo_clean$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                                        df_geo_clean$dbscan_noise_removed <- FALSE
                                                                        return(df_geo_clean)}
                                           
                                           coords_dbscan <- sf::st_coordinates(df_geo_clean)
                                           valid_dbscan_rows <- stats::complete.cases(coords_dbscan)
                                           df_dbscan_valid <- df_geo_clean[valid_dbscan_rows, ]
                                           
                                           if (nrow(df_dbscan_valid) < 5) {df_dbscan_valid$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                                           return(df_dbscan_valid)}
                                           
                                           coords_dbscan_valid <- sf::st_coordinates(df_dbscan_valid)
                                           
                                           # Estimate adaptive epsilon
                                           knn_dist <- dbscan::kNNdist(coords_dbscan_valid, k = k)
                                           Optimal_epsilon <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(knn_dist, epsilon_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
                                           
                                           # Constrain epsilon
                                           data_extent <- max(apply(coords_dbscan_valid, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE) - apply(coords_dbscan_valid, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE))
                                           eps_lower_limit <- data_extent * extent_fraction
                                           eps_upper_limit <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(knn_dist, epsilon_upper_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
                                           
                                           Optimal_epsilon <- max(min(Optimal_epsilon, eps_upper_limit), eps_lower_limit)
                                           
                                           # Adaptive minPts
                                           adaptive_minPts <- max(round(log(nrow(df_dbscan_valid)) * minPts_multiplier), minPts_floor)
                                           
                                           # Run DBSCAN
                                           DBSCAN_result <- dbscan::dbscan(coords_dbscan_valid, eps = Optimal_epsilon, minPts = adaptive_minPts)
                                           
                                           df_dbscan_valid$Cluster <- DBSCAN_result$cluster
                                           
                                           # k-NN plot
                                           knn_df <- tibble::tibble(Index = seq_along(knn_dist), kNN_distance = sort(knn_dist))
                                           
                                           knn_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(knn_df, ggplot2::aes(x = Index, y = kNN_distance)) +
                                                       ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
                                                       ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = Optimal_epsilon,
                                                                           colour = "#BE1D54",
                                                                           linetype = 2) +
                                                       journal_theme() +
                                                       ggplot2::labs(x = "Points sorted by distance",
                                                                     y = "k-NN distance")
                                           
                                           knn_plot_no_text <- knn_plot +
                                                               journal_theme_no_text() +
                                                               ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
                                           
                                           #  Cluster plot
                                           cluster_df <- tibble::tibble(X = coords_dbscan_valid[, 1],
                                                                        Y = coords_dbscan_valid[, 2],
                                                                        Cluster = DBSCAN_result$cluster) %>%
                                                         dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = dplyr::if_else(Cluster == 0, "Noise", paste0("Cluster ", Cluster)))
                                           
                                           cluster_points_df <- cluster_df %>%
                                                                dplyr::filter(Cluster != 0)
                                           
                                           noise_points_df <- cluster_df %>%
                                                              dplyr::filter(Cluster == 0)
                                           
                                           cluster_ids <- sort(unique(cluster_points_df$Cluster))
                                           cluster_labels <- paste0("Cluster ", cluster_ids)
                                           legend_labels <- c(cluster_labels, "Noise")
                                           n_clusters <- length(cluster_ids)
                                           cluster_cols <- viridisLite::rocket(n_clusters)
                                           names(cluster_cols) <- cluster_labels
                                           
                                           legend_cols <- c(cluster_cols, Noise = "black")
                                           cluster_shapes <- c(1, 17, 15, 3, 4, 8, 7, 18, 0, 2, 5, 6, 10, 12)
                                           cluster_shapes <- rep(cluster_shapes, length.out = n_clusters)
                                           names(cluster_shapes) <- cluster_labels
                                           legend_shapes <- c(cluster_shapes, Noise = 16)
                                           
                                           cluster_df <- cluster_df %>%
                                                         dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = factor(Cluster_label, levels = legend_labels))
                                           
                                           cluster_points_df <- cluster_points_df %>%
                                                                dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = factor(paste0("Cluster ", Cluster), levels = legend_labels))
                                           
                                           noise_points_df <- noise_points_df %>%
                                                              dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = factor("Noise", levels = legend_labels))
                                           
                                           hull_df <- cluster_points_df %>%
                                                      dplyr::group_by(Cluster_label) %>%
                                                      dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= 3) %>%
                                                      dplyr::slice(chull(X, Y)) %>%
                                                      dplyr::ungroup()
                                           
                                           cluster_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
                                                           ggplot2::geom_polygon(data = hull_df,
                                                                                 ggplot2::aes(x = X,
                                                                                              y = Y,
                                                                                              group = Cluster_label,
                                                                                              colour = Cluster_label,
                                                                                              fill = Cluster_label),
                                                                                 alpha = 0.14,
                                                                                 linewidth = 0.5,
                                                                                 show.legend = FALSE) +
                                                           ggplot2::geom_point(data = cluster_points_df,
                                                                               ggplot2::aes(x = X,
                                                                                            y = Y,
                                                                                            colour = Cluster_label,
                                                                                            shape = Cluster_label),
                                                                               size = 2,
                                                                               stroke = 0.7,
                                                                               show.legend = TRUE) +
                                                           ggplot2::geom_point(data = noise_points_df,
                                                                               ggplot2::aes(x = X,
                                                                                            y = Y,
                                                                                            colour = Cluster_label,
                                                                                            shape = Cluster_label),
                                                                               size = 2,
                                                                               stroke = 0.7,
                                                                               show.legend = TRUE) +
                                                           ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                                                                                        values = legend_cols,
                                                                                        breaks = legend_labels,
                                                                                        labels = legend_labels,
                                                                                        drop = FALSE) +
                                                           ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(name = NULL,
                                                                                       values = legend_shapes,
                                                                                       breaks = legend_labels,
                                                                                       labels = legend_labels,
                                                                                       drop = FALSE) +
                                                           ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols,
                                                                                      breaks = cluster_labels,
                                                                                      guide = "none") +
                                                           ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2,
                                                                                                          byrow = TRUE,
                                                                                                          override.aes = list(shape = unname(legend_shapes),
                                                                                                                              size = 3,
                                                                                                                              stroke = 0.7,
                                                                                                                              alpha = 1)),
                                                                           shape = "none",
                                                                           fill = "none") +
                                                           journal_theme() +
                                                           ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                                                                          legend.direction = "horizontal",
                                                                          legend.box = "horizontal",
                                                                          legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()) +
                                                           ggplot2::labs(x = "X",
                                                                         y = "Y")
                                           
                                           cluster_plot_no_text <- cluster_plot +
                                                                   journal_theme_no_text() +
                                                                   ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
                                           
                                           # Export plots
                                           if (isTRUE(export_plots)) {output_paths <- list(knn_plot = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_knn_distance_plot.tiff")),
                                                                                                                   plot = knn_plot,
                                                                                                                   width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                   height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                   dpi = figure_dpi),
                                                                                           knn_plot_no_text = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_knn_distance_plot_no_text.tiff")),
                                                                                                                           plot = knn_plot_no_text,
                                                                                                                           width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                           height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                           dpi = figure_dpi),
                                                                                           cluster_plot = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_Cluster_plot.tiff")),
                                                                                                                       plot = cluster_plot,
                                                                                                                       width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                       height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                       dpi = figure_dpi),
                                                                                           cluster_plot_no_text = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_Cluster_plot_no_text.tiff")),
                                                                                                                               plot = cluster_plot_no_text,
                                                                                                                               width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                               height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                               dpi = figure_dpi))}
                                           
                                           return(df_dbscan_valid)}
Datasets2 <- purrr::imap(Datasets2,
                         ~ geonoise(df = .x, dataset_name = .y, output_dir = "OutputInputCluster_no_covariates2Input", export_plots = TRUE))
```

# Vizualize distribution
```{r distribution}
make_overview_map <- function(df, show_text = TRUE) {breaks <- unique(c(0, 0.5, 1, 3, 5, 7, 10,
                                                                        seq(20,
                                                                            ceiling(max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10,
                                                                            by = 10)))

                                                     breaks <- breaks[breaks <= max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE)]
                                                     breaks <- sort(unique(c(breaks, max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE))))
                                                     
                                                     pal <- leaflet::colorBin(reverse = TRUE,
                                                                              na.color = "transparent",
                                                                              palette = viridisLite::viridis(n = length(breaks) - 1,
                                                                                                             option = "F",
                                                                                                             end = 0.9),
                                                                              domain = df$value,
                                                                              bins = breaks)
                                                     
                                                     colourbar_legend <- make_horizontal_colourbar_legend(pal = pal,
                                                                                                          values = df$value,
                                                                                                          title = "β-thalassaemia carrier prevalence (%)",
                                                                                                          show_text = show_text,
                                                                                                          accuracy = 0.01,
                                                                                                          comma_labels = FALSE)
                                                     
                                                     df %>%
                                                     leaflet::leaflet(width = 1500,
                                                                      height = 750,
                                                                      options = leaflet::leafletOptions(minZoom = 2,
                                                                                                        worldCopyJump = FALSE)) %>%
                                                     leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.PositronNoLabels",
                                                                               options = leaflet::providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
                                                     leaflet::addScaleBar(position = c("bottomleft")) %>%
                                                     leaflet::setView(lng = 70, lat = 30, zoom = 4) %>%
                                                     leaflet::addCircleMarkers(radius = 6,
                                                                               color = ~pal(value),
                                                                               stroke = FALSE,
                                                                               fillOpacity = 0.8) %>%
                                                     leaflet::addControl(html = colourbar_legend,
                                                                         position = "bottomleft")}

Visual_Overview  <- make_overview_map(Datasets2$`Dataset 8`, show_text = TRUE)
Visual_Overview2 <- make_overview_map(Datasets2$`Dataset 8`, show_text = FALSE)
```

```{r temporal figure}
plot_data <- Datasets2$`Dataset 8` %>%
             st_drop_geometry() %>%
             left_join(read.csv("Input/Uploaded-data_EPI-RAF.csv") %>%
                         dplyr::select(source_id, citation_str) %>%
                         distinct(), by = "source_id") %>%
             mutate(year = str_extract(citation_str, "\\b(19|20)\\d{2}\\b"),
                    year = as.integer(year)) %>%
             dplyr::select(source_id, year) %>%
             distinct() %>%
             group_by(year) %>%
             summarise(n_records = n(),
                       .groups = "drop") %>%
             arrange(year) %>%
             mutate(cumulative_records = cumsum(n_records),
                    cumulative_prop = cumulative_records / sum(n_records))

scale_factor <- left_axis_max

     geom_col(aes(y = n_records),
              width = 0.55,
              fill = "grey45",
```
