# Generate 5 overall partitions
generate_partitions <- function(n_items,
                                n_groups) {if (n_groups > n_items) {stop("'n_groups' cannot exceed 'n_items'.")}
                                           if (n_groups < 1L) {stop("'n_groups' must be at least 1.")}
  
                                           current_partition <- integer(n_items)
                                           current_partition[1] <- 1L
                                           results <- list()
                                           recurse <- function(position, current_maximum) {if (position > n_items) {if (current_maximum == n_groups) {results[[length(results) + 1L]] <<- current_partition}
                                                                                                                                                      return(invisible(NULL))}
                                                                                                                    maximum_allowed <- min(current_maximum + 1L,
                                                                                                                                           n_groups)
                                                                                                                    for (group_id in seq_len(maximum_allowed)) {new_maximum <- max(current_maximum, group_id)
                                                                                                                                                                positions_remaining <- n_items - position
                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                # Prune branches that cannot reach the required number of final groups
                                                                                                                                                                if (new_maximum + positions_remaining < n_groups) {next}
                                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                current_partition[position] <<- group_id
                                                                                                                                                                recurse(position = position + 1L,
                                                                                                                                                                        current_maximum = new_maximum)}}
                                           if (n_items == 1L) {if (n_groups == 1L) {return(matrix(1L, nrow = 1L))}
                                                               stop("Invalid partition dimensions.")}
                                          
                                            recurse(position = 2L, current_maximum = 1L)
                                            do.call(rbind, results)}

# Construct one outer polygon for each cluster
build_cluster_boundaries <- function(data,
                                     cluster_column = "Cluster",
                                     metric_crs = 6933,
                                     hull_ratio = 0.25,
                                     fallback_buffer_km = 10) {if (!inherits(data, "sf")) {stop("'data' must be an sf object.")}
                                                               if (!cluster_column %in% names(data)) {stop(paste0("Column '", cluster_column, "' was not found."))}
                                                               if (hull_ratio < 0 || hull_ratio > 1) {stop("'hull_ratio' must be between 0 and 1.")}
                                                               if (fallback_buffer_km <= 0) {stop("'fallback_buffer_km' must be greater than zero.")}
  
                                                               cluster_values <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(data[[cluster_column]])))
                                                               invalid_cluster_values <- (is.na(cluster_values) & !is.na(data[[cluster_column]]))
                                                               valid_rows <- which(!is.na(cluster_values))
                                                               
                                                               if (length(valid_rows) == 0L) {stop("No valid cluster assignments were found.")}
                                                               
                                                               metric_data <- sf::st_transform(data, metric_crs)
                                                               representative_points <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_point_on_surface(metric_data))
                                                               representative_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(representative_points)
                                                               
                                                               if (nrow(representative_coordinates) != nrow(metric_data)) {stop(paste0("The supplied geometry does not yield exactly one ", "representative coordinate per observation."))}
                                                               
                                                               cluster_ids <- sort(unique(cluster_values[valid_rows]))
                                                               boundary_geometries <- vector( mode = "list", length = length(cluster_ids))
                                                               cluster_sizes <- integer(length(cluster_ids))
                                                               
                                                               for (cluster_position in seq_along(cluster_ids)) {cluster_id <- cluster_ids[cluster_position]
                                                                                                                 cluster_rows <- which(cluster_values == cluster_id)
                                                                                                                 cluster_sizes[cluster_position] <- length(cluster_rows)
                                                                                                                 cluster_points <- representative_points[cluster_rows,]
                                                                                                                 combined_points <- sf::st_combine(sf::st_geometry(cluster_points))
                                                                                                                 unique_coordinates <- unique(sf::st_coordinates(combined_points)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
                                                                                                                 number_of_unique_locations <- nrow(unique_coordinates)
                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                 if (number_of_unique_locations >= 3L) {cluster_hull <- tryCatch(sf::st_concave_hull(combined_points,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     ratio = hull_ratio,
                                                                                                                                                                                                     allow_holes = FALSE),
                                                                                                                                                                                 error = function(error_condition) {warning(paste0("Concave-hull construction failed for cluster ",
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   cluster_id,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   ". A convex hull was used instead."))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                    sf::st_convex_hull(combined_points)})} 
                                                                                                                 else {cluster_hull <- sf::st_buffer(sf::st_convex_hull(combined_points),
                                                                                                                                                     dist = fallback_buffer_km * 1000)}
                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                 cluster_hull <- sf::st_make_valid(cluster_hull)
                                                                                                                 hull_type <- as.character(sf::st_geometry_type(cluster_hull))
                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                 if (    sf::st_is_empty(cluster_hull) || !hull_type %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON")) {cluster_hull <- sf::st_buffer(cluster_hull,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       dist = fallback_buffer_km * 1000)}
                                                                                                                 boundary_geometries[[cluster_position]] <- sf::st_geometry(cluster_hull)[[1]]}
                                                               
                                                               boundary_sfc <- do.call(sf::st_sfc, c(boundary_geometries, list(crs = metric_crs)))
                                                               
                                                               sf::st_sf(cluster_id = cluster_ids, cluster_size = cluster_sizes, geometry = boundary_sfc)}
# Adjacency matrix
find_adjacency_components <- function(adjacency) {number_of_nodes <- nrow(adjacency)
                                                  component_id <- rep(NA_integer_, number_of_nodes)
                                                  current_component <- 0L
                                                  for (start_node in seq_len(number_of_nodes)) {if (!is.na(component_id[start_node])) {next}
                                                                                                current_component <- current_component + 1L
                                                                                                frontier <- start_node
                                                                                                component_id[start_node] <- current_component
                                                                                                while (length(frontier) > 0L) {current_node <- frontier[1]
                                                                                                                               frontier <- frontier[-1]
                                                                                                                               neighbours <- which(adjacency[current_node, ])
                                                                                                                               unvisited_neighbours <- neighbours[is.na(component_id[neighbours])]
                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                               if (length(unvisited_neighbours) > 0L) {component_id[unvisited_neighbours] <- current_component
                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                       frontier <- c(frontier, unvisited_neighbours)}}}
                                                  component_id}

# Construct a Voronoi territory per cluster. Two clusters are neighbours when their territories share an edge.
build_boundary_adjacency <- function(data,
                                     cluster_column = "Cluster",
                                     metric_crs = 6933,
                                     envelope_buffer_km = 250,
                                     contiguity = c("rook", "queen"),
                                     ...) {contiguity <- match.arg(contiguity)
                                           if (!inherits(data, "sf")) {stop("'data' must be an sf object.")}
                                           if (!cluster_column %in% names(data)) {stop(paste0("Column '", cluster_column, "' was not found."))}
                                           if (envelope_buffer_km <= 0) {stop("'envelope_buffer_km' must be greater than zero.")}
                                     
                                           cluster_values <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(data[[cluster_column]])))
                                           invalid_values <- (is.na(cluster_values) & !is.na(data[[cluster_column]]))
                                           
                                           if (any(invalid_values)) {stop("Some Cluster values could not be converted to integers.")}
                                           
                                           valid_rows <- which(!is.na(cluster_values))
                                           
                                           if (length(valid_rows) == 0L) {stop("No valid cluster assignments were found.")}
                                           
                                           cluster_ids <- sort(unique(cluster_values[valid_rows]))
                                           number_of_clusters <- length(cluster_ids)
                                           
                                           if (number_of_clusters < 2L) {stop("At least two clusters are required to construct adjacency.")}
                                           
                                           metric_data <- sf::st_transform(data[valid_rows, ], metric_crs)
                                           representative_points <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_point_on_surface(metric_data))
                                           coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(representative_points)
                                           
                                           if (nrow(coordinates) != nrow(representative_points)) {stop(paste0("The supplied geometries did not produce exactly one ",
                                                                                                              "representative location per observation."))}
                                           
                                           site_table <- data.frame(cluster_id = cluster_values[valid_rows],
                                                                    X = coordinates[, 1],
                                                                    Y = coordinates[, 2])
                                           
                                           coordinate_check <- site_table %>%
                                                               dplyr::group_by(X, Y) %>%
                                                               dplyr::summarise(number_of_clusters = dplyr::n_distinct(cluster_id), .groups = "drop")
                                           
                                           conflicting_coordinates <- coordinate_check %>%
                                                                      dplyr::filter(number_of_clusters > 1L)
                                           
                                           if (nrow(conflicting_coordinates) > 0L) {stop(paste0("At least one coordinate is assigned to more than one ",
                                                                                                "cluster. Voronoi territories cannot distinguish clusters ",
                                                                                                "at exactly identical coordinates."))}
                                           
                                           unique_sites <- site_table %>%
                                                           dplyr::distinct(X, Y, .keep_all = TRUE)
                                           
                                           sites <- sf::st_as_sf(unique_sites,
                                                                 coords = c("X", "Y"),
                                                                 crs = metric_crs)
                                           
                                           if (nrow(sites) < 2L) {stop("At least two unique spatial locations are required.")}
                                           
                                           combined_sites <- sf::st_union(sf::st_geometry(sites))
                                           study_envelope <- sf::st_buffer(sf::st_convex_hull(combined_sites),
                                                                           dist = envelope_buffer_km * 1000)
                                           study_envelope <- sf::st_make_valid(study_envelope)
                                           study_envelope_sf <- sf::st_sf(geometry = study_envelope)
                                           
                                           voronoi_collection <- sf::st_voronoi(combined_sites, envelope = study_envelope[[1]])
                                           voronoi_geometry <- sf::st_collection_extract(voronoi_collection, "POLYGON")
                                           voronoi_cells <- sf::st_sf(cell_id = seq_along(voronoi_geometry), geometry = voronoi_geometry)
                                           voronoi_cells <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(voronoi_cells, study_envelope_sf))
                                           
                                           if (nrow(voronoi_cells) == 0L) {stop("Voronoi construction produced no polygon cells.")}
                                           
                                           cell_reference_points <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_point_on_surface(voronoi_cells))
                                           generating_site_position <- sf::st_nearest_feature(cell_reference_points, sites)
                                           voronoi_cells$cluster_id <- sites$cluster_id[generating_site_position] 
                                           
                                           cluster_boundaries <- voronoi_cells %>%
                                                                 dplyr::group_by(cluster_id) %>%
                                                                 dplyr::summarise(geometry = sf::st_union(geometry), .groups = "drop") %>%
                                                                 sf::st_make_valid()
                                           
                                           cluster_counts <- data.frame(cluster_id = cluster_values[valid_rows]) %>%
                                                             dplyr::count(cluster_id, name = "cluster_size")
                                           
                                           cluster_boundaries <- cluster_boundaries %>%
                                                                 dplyr::left_join(cluster_counts, by = "cluster_id") %>%
                                                                 dplyr::arrange(cluster_id)
                                           
                                           cluster_ids <- cluster_boundaries$cluster_id
                                           number_of_clusters <- nrow(cluster_boundaries)
                                           
                                           # Define adjacency from shared territorial boundaries [Rook contiguity: polygons must share a boundary segment, not merely one point.]
                                           if (contiguity == "rook") {adjacency_matrix <- sf::st_relate(cluster_boundaries,
                                                                                                        cluster_boundaries,
                                                                                                        pattern = "F***1****",
                                                                                                        sparse = FALSE)} 
                                           
                                           else {# Queen contiguity: sharing either an edge or a corner is sufficient.
                                                 adjacency_matrix <- sf::st_touches(cluster_boundaries,
                                                                                    cluster_boundaries,
                                                                                    sparse = FALSE)}
                                           
                                           diag(adjacency_matrix) <- TRUE
                                           dimnames(adjacency_matrix) <- list(as.character(cluster_ids),
                                                                              as.character(cluster_ids))
                                           
                                           outer_boundary_lines <- sf::st_boundary(cluster_boundaries)
                                           boundary_distance_units <- sf::st_distance(outer_boundary_lines,
                                                                                      outer_boundary_lines)
                                           boundary_distance_m <- matrix(as.numeric(boundary_distance_units),
                                                                         nrow = number_of_clusters,
                                                                         ncol = number_of_clusters,
                                                                         dimnames = list(as.character(cluster_ids),
                                                                                         as.character(cluster_ids)))
                                           
                                           diag(boundary_distance_m) <- 0
                                           
                                           all_pairs <- t(utils::combn(seq_len(number_of_clusters), 2))
                                           included_pairs <- all_pairs[adjacency_matrix[cbind(all_pairs[, 1], all_pairs[, 2])],, drop = FALSE]
                                           
                                           if (nrow(included_pairs) > 0L) {shared_boundary_km <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(included_pairs)),
                                                                                                        function(pair_index) {first_position <- included_pairs[pair_index, 1]
                                                                                                                              second_position <- included_pairs[pair_index, 2]
                                                                                                                              first_boundary <- sf::st_geometry(outer_boundary_lines[first_position, ])
                                                                                                                              second_boundary <- sf::st_geometry(outer_boundary_lines[second_position, ])
                                                                                                                              shared_geometry <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(first_boundary, second_boundary))
                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                              if (length(shared_geometry) == 0L || all(sf::st_is_empty(shared_geometry))) {return(0)}
                                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                              as.numeric(sum(sf::st_length(shared_geometry))) / 1000}, 
                                                                                                        numeric(1))
                                                                                                        edge_table <- data.frame(cluster_1 = cluster_ids[included_pairs[, 1]],
                                                                                                                                 cluster_2 = cluster_ids[included_pairs[, 2]],
                                                                                                                                 boundary_gap_km = 0,
                                                                                                                                 shared_boundary_km = shared_boundary_km,
                                                                                                                                 polygon_contact = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                 adjacency_before_bridging = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                 edge_type = "Boundary contact or overlap",
                                                                                                                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)} 
                                           
                                           else {edge_table <- data.frame(cluster_1 = integer(0),
                                                                          cluster_2 = integer(0),
                                                                          boundary_gap_km = numeric(0),
                                                                          shared_boundary_km = numeric(0),
                                                                          polygon_contact = logical(0),
                                                                          adjacency_before_bridging = logical(0),
                                                                          edge_type = character(0),
                                                                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)}
                                           
                                           component_ids <- find_adjacency_components(adjacency_matrix)
                                           component_table <- data.frame(cluster_id = cluster_ids,
                                                                         component_id = component_ids)
                                           
                                           list(adjacency = adjacency_matrix,
                                                adjacency_before_bridging = adjacency_matrix,
                                                boundaries = cluster_boundaries,
                                                outer_boundary_lines = outer_boundary_lines,
                                                boundary_distance_m = boundary_distance_m,
                                                edge_table = edge_table,
                                                component_table = component_table,
                                                contiguity = contiguity,
                                                envelope_buffer_km = envelope_buffer_km,
                                                study_envelope = study_envelope_sf)}


is_connected_group <- function(member_indices,
                               adjacency) {if (length(member_indices) <= 1L) {return(TRUE)}
                                           visited <- member_indices[1]
                                           frontier <- member_indices[1]
                                           while (length(frontier) > 0L) {current <- frontier[1]
                                                                          frontier <- frontier[-1]
                                                                          neighbours <- member_indices[adjacency[current, member_indices]]
                                                                          new_neighbours <- setdiff(neighbours, visited)
                                                                          
                                                                          if (length(new_neighbours) > 0L) {visited <- c(visited, new_neighbours)
                                                                                                            frontier <- c(frontier, new_neighbours)}}
                                           
                                           length(unique(visited)) == length(member_indices)}


merge_clusters_balanced <- function(data,
                                    cluster_column = "Cluster",
                                    target_clusters = 5L,
                                    balance_tolerance = 0.25,
                                    metric_crs = 6933,
                                    hull_ratio = 0.25,
                                    neighbour_gap_km = 0,
                                    fallback_buffer_km = 10,
                                    ensure_connected = FALSE) {if (!inherits(data, "sf")) {stop("'data' must be an sf object.")}
                                                               if (!cluster_column %in% names(data)) {stop(paste0("Column '", cluster_column, "' was not found."))}
                                                               if (balance_tolerance < 0 || balance_tolerance >= 1) {stop("'balance_tolerance' must be between 0 and 1.")}
  
                                                               cluster_values <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(as.character(data[[cluster_column]])))
                                                               invalid_cluster_values <- (is.na(cluster_values) & !is.na(data[[cluster_column]]))
                                                               
                                                               valid_rows <- which(!is.na(cluster_values))
                                                               
                                                               if (length(valid_rows) == 0) {stop("No valid cluster assignments were found.")}
                                                               
                                                               original_cluster_ids <- sort(unique(cluster_values[valid_rows]))
                                                               initial_cluster_count <- length(original_cluster_ids)
                                                               
                                                               if (initial_cluster_count < target_clusters) {stop(paste0("Only ", initial_cluster_count, " clusters are present, fewer than the target of ", target_clusters, "."))}
                                                               
                                                               metric_data <- sf::st_transform(data, metric_crs)
                                                               point_coordinates <- sf::st_coordinates(metric_data)
                                                               point_summary <- data.frame(cluster_id = cluster_values,
                                                                                           X = point_coordinates[, 1],
                                                                                           Y = point_coordinates[, 2]) %>%
                                                                                dplyr::filter(!is.na(cluster_id),
                                                                                              is.finite(X),
                                                                                              is.finite(Y))
                                                               
                                                               cluster_summary <- point_summary %>%
                                                                                  dplyr::group_by(cluster_id) %>%
                                                                                  dplyr::summarise(cluster_size = dplyr::n(),
                                                                                                   centroid_X = mean(X),
                                                                                                   centroid_Y = mean(Y),
                                                                                                   .groups = "drop") %>%
                                                                                  dplyr::arrange(cluster_id)
                                                               
                                                               initial_cluster_count <- nrow(cluster_summary)
                                                               total_observations <- sum(cluster_summary$cluster_size)
                                                               target_size <- total_observations / target_clusters
                                                               minimum_acceptable_size <- floor(target_size * (1 - balance_tolerance))
                                                               maximum_acceptable_size <- ceiling(target_size * (1 + balance_tolerance))
                                                               oversized_original_clusters <- cluster_summary %>%
                                                                                              dplyr::filter(cluster_size > maximum_acceptable_size)
                                                               
                                                               if (nrow(oversized_original_clusters) > 0) {warning(paste0("At least one original cluster already exceeds the ",
                                                                                                                          "maximum balanced size of ",
                                                                                                                          maximum_acceptable_size,
                                                                                                                          ". Merging cannot reduce its size. ",
                                                                                                                          "A fully balanced result may require splitting or ",
                                                                                                                          "reclustering that cluster."))
                                                                 
                                                                                                           print(oversized_original_clusters)}
                                                               
                                                               boundary_graph <- build_boundary_adjacency(data = data,
                                                                                                          cluster_column = cluster_column,
                                                                                                          metric_crs = metric_crs,
                                                                                                          hull_ratio = hull_ratio,
                                                                                                          neighbour_gap_km = neighbour_gap_km,
                                                                                                          fallback_buffer_km = fallback_buffer_km,
                                                                                                          ensure_connected = ensure_connected)
                                                               
                                                               cluster_order <- as.character(cluster_summary$cluster_id)
                                                               geographic_adjacency <- boundary_graph$adjacency[cluster_order, cluster_order, drop = FALSE]
                                                               component_count <- max(find_adjacency_components(geographic_adjacency))
                                                               
                                                               if (component_count > target_clusters) {stop(paste0("The boundary-neighbour graph contains ", component_count, " disconnected components, but only ", target_clusters,
                                                                                                                   " final clusters were requested. A connected merge ", "cannot cross disconnected components. Increase ", 
                                                                                                                   "'neighbour_gap_km', set 'ensure_connected = TRUE', ", "or request at least ", component_count, " final clusters."))}
                                                               
                                                               all_partitions <- generate_partitions(n_items = initial_cluster_count,
                                                                                                     n_groups = target_clusters)
                                                               
                                                               number_of_partitions <- nrow(all_partitions)
                                                               candidate_results <- vector(mode = "list", length = number_of_partitions)
                                                               candidate_group_sizes <- vector(mode = "list", length = number_of_partitions)
                                                               
                                                               # Evaluate every geographically contiguous merge configuration 
                                                               for (partition_index in seq_len(number_of_partitions)) {group_assignment <- all_partitions[partition_index,]
                                                                                                                       geographically_contiguous <- all(vapply(seq_len(target_clusters),
                                                                                                                                                               function(group_id) {is_connected_group(member_indices = which(group_assignment == group_id),
                                                                                                                                                                                                      adjacency = geographic_adjacency)},
                                                                                                                                                               logical(1)))
                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                       if (!geographically_contiguous) {next}
                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                       group_sizes <- vapply(seq_len(target_clusters),
                                                                                                                                             function(group_id) {sum(cluster_summary$cluster_size[group_assignment == group_id])},
                                                                                                                                             numeric(1))
                                                                                                                       
                                                                                                                       relative_deviations <- abs(group_sizes - target_size) / target_size
                                                                                                                       balance_rmse <- sqrt(mean(((group_sizes - target_size) / target_size)^2))
                                                                                                                       maximum_relative_deviation <- max(relative_deviations)
                                                                                                                       within_tolerance <- all(group_sizes >= minimum_acceptable_size & group_sizes <= maximum_acceptable_size)
                                                                                                                       candidate_results[[partition_index]] <- data.frame(partition_id = partition_index,
                                                                                                                                                                          balance_rmse = balance_rmse,
                                                                                                                                                                          maximum_relative_deviation = maximum_relative_deviation,
                                                                                                                                                                          minimum_group_size = min(group_sizes),
                                                                                                                                                                          maximum_group_size = max(group_sizes),
                                                                                                                                                                          size_range = max(group_sizes) - min(group_sizes),
                                                                                                                                                                          within_tolerance = within_tolerance,
                                                                                                                                                                          geographically_contiguous = TRUE)
                                                                                                                       candidate_group_sizes[[partition_index]] <- group_sizes}
                                                               
                                                               candidate_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(candidate_results)
                                                               
                                                               if (nrow(candidate_results) == 0L) {stop(paste0("No geographically contiguous partition into ",
                                                                                                               target_clusters,
                                                                                                               " final clusters was found."))}
                                                                 
                                                               if (any(candidate_results$within_tolerance)) {eligible_candidates <- candidate_results %>%
                                                                                                                                    dplyr::filter(within_tolerance)
                                                               
                                                                                                             tolerance_satisfied <- TRUE}
                                                               
                                                               else {warning(paste0("No geographically contiguous whole-cluster merge places all ",
                                                                                    target_clusters, " clusters within ±", balance_tolerance * 100,
                                                                                    "% of the target size. The geographically contiguous solution ",
                                                                                    "with the closest achievable size balance will be returned."))
                                                                 
                                                                     eligible_candidates <- candidate_results
                                                                     tolerance_satisfied <- FALSE}
                                                               
                                                              eligible_candidates <- eligible_candidates %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::arrange(maximum_relative_deviation, balance_rmse)
                                                              
                                                              best_candidate <- eligible_candidates %>% dplyr::slice(1)
                                                              best_partition_id <- best_candidate$partition_id
                                                              best_assignment <- all_partitions[best_partition_id,]
                                                              best_group_sizes <- candidate_group_sizes[[best_partition_id]]
                                                              
                                                              # Relabel final clusters from west to east
                                                              cluster_mapping <- cluster_summary %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::mutate(provisional_group = best_assignment)
                                                              
                                                              group_locations <- cluster_mapping %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::group_by(provisional_group) %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::summarise(group_centroid_X = stats::weighted.mean(centroid_X, cluster_size), .groups = "drop") %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::arrange(group_centroid_X) %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::mutate(final_cluster = dplyr::row_number())
                                                              
                                                              cluster_mapping <- cluster_mapping %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::left_join(group_locations, by = "provisional_group") %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::select(original_cluster = cluster_id,
                                                                                               original_cluster_size = cluster_size,
                                                                                               provisional_group,
                                                                                               final_cluster) %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::arrange(final_cluster)
                                                              
                                                              output_data <- data
                                                              
                                                              output_data$Cluster_before_balanced_merge <- cluster_values
                                                              output_data[[cluster_column]] <- cluster_mapping$final_cluster[match(cluster_values, cluster_mapping$original_cluster)]
                                                              final_cluster_counts <- output_data %>%
                                                                                      sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                                                      dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[cluster_column]])) %>%
                                                                                      dplyr::count(.data[[cluster_column]], name = "cluster_size")
                                                              
                                                              names(final_cluster_counts)[1] <- "Cluster"
                                                              final_cluster_counts <- final_cluster_counts %>%
                                                                                      dplyr::mutate(target_size = target_size,
                                                                                                    difference_from_target = cluster_size - target_size,
                                                                                                    relative_difference = difference_from_target / target_size)
                                                              
                                                              list(data = output_data,
                                                                   mapping = cluster_mapping,
                                                                   final_counts = final_cluster_counts,
                                                                   selected_solution = best_candidate,
                                                                   all_candidate_solutions = candidate_results,
                                                                   target_size = target_size,
                                                                   minimum_acceptable_size = minimum_acceptable_size,
                                                                   maximum_acceptable_size = maximum_acceptable_size,
                                                                   tolerance_satisfied = tolerance_satisfied,
                                                                   geographic_adjacency = geographic_adjacency,
                                                                   selected_group_sizes = best_group_sizes,
                                                                   cluster_boundaries = boundary_graph$boundaries,
                                                                   boundary_edges = boundary_graph$edge_table,
                                                                   boundary_distance_m = boundary_graph$boundary_distance_m,
                                                                   boundary_components = boundary_graph$component_table,
                                                                   boundary_graph = boundary_graph)}

balanced_result <- merge_clusters_balanced(data = final_data,
                                           cluster_column = "Cluster",
                                           target_clusters = 5L,
                                           balance_tolerance = 0.25,
                                           metric_crs = 6933,
                                           hull_ratio = HULL_RATIO,
                                           neighbour_gap_km = NEIGHBOUR_GAP_KM,
                                           fallback_buffer_km = FALLBACK_BUFFER_KM,
                                           ensure_connected = ENSURE_CONNECTED)

final_data <- balanced_result$data

                                                                                                                                                                         paste(names(ADM0), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)}

Check that ", adm0_data_col, " in the dataset matches ", adm0_boundary_col, " in ADM0.gpkg.", call. = FALSE)}

                                                                                                                          INLA::inla.mesh.segment(loc = lonlat3D(coords[, 1], coords[, 2]), is.bnd = TRUE)})
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Boundary_loc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Segments, function(x) x$loc))
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Indexing <- list()
                                                                                       Offset <- 0
                                                                                       
                                                                                       for (s in Segments) {Indexing[[length(Indexing) + 1]] <- matrix(s$idx + Offset, ncol = ncol(s$idx))
                                                                                                            Offset <- Offset + nrow(s$loc)}
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Indexing <- do.call(rbind, Indexing)
                                                                                       
                                                                                       Boundary <- INLA::inla.mesh.segment(loc = Boundary_loc, idx = Indexing, is.bnd = TRUE)
                                                                                       Boundary$idx <- Boundary$idx[, 2:1]
                                                                                       
                                                                                       list(ADM0 = ADM0, Boundary = Boundary)}
                                                        
                                                        get_r0 <- function(ADM0) {ee <- raster::extent(ADM0)
                                                                                  true.radius.of.earth <- 6371
                                                                                  
                                                                                  as.numeric(0.05 * fields::rdist.earth(matrix(c(ee[1], ee[3]), ncol = 2),
                                                                                                                        matrix(c(ee[2], ee[4]), ncol = 2),
                                                                                                                        miles = FALSE,
                                                                                                                        R = true.radius.of.earth))}
                                                        
                                                        get_latent_index <- function(model, tag) {contents <- model$misc$configs$contents
                                                        
                                                                                                  if (!tag %in% contents$tag) {return(NA_integer_)}
                                                        
                                                                                                  contents$start[contents$tag == tag]}
                                                        
                                                        get_spatial_indices <- function(model) {contents <- model$misc$configs$contents
