```{r priority sites}
# Selection of up to 30 best space-filling sites per country amongst candidates
make_local_aeqd_crs <- function(Data) {if (!inherits(Data, "sf")) {stop("Data must be an sf object.", call. = FALSE)}
  
                                       Data <- sf::st_transform(Data, 4326)
                                       
                                       Centre <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_centroid(sf::st_union(sf::st_geometry(Data))))
                                       Centre_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(Centre)[1, 1:2]
                                       
                                       paste0("+proj=aeqd ",
                                              "+lat_0=", Centre_xy[2], " ",
                                              "+lon_0=", Centre_xy[1], " ",
                                              "+datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")}

get_lonlat <- function(Data) {if (!inherits(Data, "sf")) {stop("Data must be an sf object.", call. = FALSE)}
                              Data <- sf::st_transform(Data, 4326)
                              xy <- sf::st_coordinates(Data)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
                              if (nrow(xy) != nrow(Data)) {stop("st_coordinates() does not return one coordinate per row. ",
                                                                "This selection code assumes POINT geometries.",
                                                                call. = FALSE)}
                              xy <- as.data.frame(xy)
                              names(xy) <- c("x", "y")
                              xy}

geodist_matrix_m <- function(A,
                             B,
                             measure = "geodesic") {geodist::geodist(x = get_lonlat(A),
                                                                     y = get_lonlat(B),
                                                                     paired = FALSE,
                                                                     measure = measure)}

make_coord_key <- function(coords,
                           digits = 6) {paste(round(coords[, 1], digits),
                                              round(coords[, 2], digits),
                                              sep = "_")}

choose_candidate_batch_cover <- function(remaining,
                                         existing,
                                         n_choose,
                                         nruns = 1,
                                         coord_digits = 6) {if (!inherits(remaining, "sf")) {stop("remaining must be an sf object.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                            if (!inherits(existing, "sf")) {stop("existing must be an sf object.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                            if (nrow(remaining) == 0) {return(integer(0))}
  
                                                            n_choose <- min(n_choose, nrow(remaining))
                                                            
                                                            if (n_choose <= 0) {return(integer(0))}
                                                            
                                                            Design_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(existing %>%
                                                                                            dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geometry),
                                                                                            remaining %>%
                                                                                            dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geometry))
                                                            
                                                            Design_data <- Design_data[!sf::st_is_empty(Design_data), ]
                                                            
                                                            if (nrow(Design_data) == 0) {stop("No valid geometries available for cover.design().", call. = FALSE)}
                                                            
                                                            design_crs <- make_local_aeqd_crs(Design_data)
                                                            remaining_projected <- sf::st_transform(remaining, design_crs)
                                                            remaining_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(remaining_projected)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
                                                            
                                                            if (nrow(remaining_coords) != nrow(remaining)) {stop("st_coordinates() does not return one coordinate per remaining row.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                            if (any(!stats::complete.cases(remaining_coords))) {stop("Some remaining candidate coordinates are invalid.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                            
                                                            remaining_index <- seq_len(nrow(remaining))
                                                            remaining_key <- make_coord_key(remaining_coords, digits = coord_digits)
                                                            
                                                            keep_remaining_unique <- !duplicated(remaining_key)
                                                            remaining_coords <- remaining_coords[keep_remaining_unique, , drop = FALSE]
                                                            remaining_index <- remaining_index[keep_remaining_unique]
                                                            
                                                            if (nrow(remaining_coords) == 0) {return(integer(0))}
                                                            
                                                            n_choose <- min(n_choose, nrow(remaining_coords))
                                                            
                                                            if (n_choose >= nrow(remaining_coords)) {return(as.integer(remaining_index))}
                                                            if (nrow(existing) == 0) {design <- fields::cover.design(R = remaining_coords,
                                                                                                                     nd = n_choose,
                                                                                                                     nruns = nruns)
                                                                                      return(as.integer(remaining_index[design$best.id]))}
                                                            
                                                            existing_projected <- sf::st_transform(existing, design_crs)
                                                            existing_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(existing_projected)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
                                                            existing_coords <- existing_coords[stats::complete.cases(existing_coords),, drop = FALSE]
                                                            
                                                            if (nrow(existing_coords) == 0) {stop("Existing sampled/selected coordinates are invalid.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                            
                                                            existing_key <- make_coord_key(existing_coords, digits = coord_digits)
                                                            keep_existing_unique <- !duplicated(existing_key)
                                                            existing_coords <- existing_coords[keep_existing_unique,, drop = FALSE]
                                                            existing_key <- make_coord_key(existing_coords, digits = coord_digits)
                                                            remaining_key <- make_coord_key(remaining_coords, digits = coord_digits)
                                                            keep_remaining_not_existing <- !remaining_key %in% existing_key
                                                            remaining_coords <- remaining_coords[keep_remaining_not_existing,, drop = FALSE]
                                                            remaining_index <- remaining_index[keep_remaining_not_existing]
                                                            
                                                            if (nrow(remaining_coords) == 0) {return(integer(0))}
                                                            
                                                            n_choose <- min(n_choose, nrow(remaining_coords))
                                                            
                                                            if (n_choose >= nrow(remaining_coords)) {return(as.integer(remaining_index))}
                                                            
                                                            n_existing <- nrow(existing_coords)
                                                            
                                                            all_coords <- rbind(existing_coords, remaining_coords)
                                                            
                                                            design <- fields::cover.design(R = all_coords,
                                                                                           nd = n_choose,
                                                                                           fixed = seq_len(n_existing),
                                                                                           nruns = nruns,
                                                                                           nn = FALSE)
                                                            
                                                            selected_candidate_ids <- design$best.id[design$best.id > n_existing]
                                                            
                                                            if (length(selected_candidate_ids) == 0) {return(integer(0))}
                                                            
                                                            selected_candidate_ids <- selected_candidate_ids - n_existing
                                                            as.integer(remaining_index[selected_candidate_ids])}


Select_space_filling <- function(Candidates,
                                 Sampled,
                                 threshold_name = NA_character_,
                                 n_sites_per_country = 30,
                                 min_distance_m = 50000,
                                 nruns = 1,
                                 geodist_measure = "geodesic") {if (!inherits(Candidates, "sf")) {stop("Candidates must be an sf object.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                                if (!inherits(Sampled, "sf")) {stop("Sampled must be an sf object.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                                if (!"geo_admin0" %in% names(Candidates)) {stop("Candidates must contain geo_admin0.", call. = FALSE)}
                                                                if (!"geo_admin0" %in% names(Sampled)) {stop("Sampled must contain geo_admin0.", call. = FALSE)}
  
                                                                Candidates <- Candidates %>%
                                                                              sf::st_transform(4326)
                                                                
                                                                Sampled <- Sampled %>%
                                                                           sf::st_transform(4326)
                                                                
                                                                candidate_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(Candidates)[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
                                                                
                                                                Candidates <- Candidates[stats::complete.cases(candidate_xy) & !is.na(Candidates$geo_admin0),]
                                                                
                                                                if (!"lon" %in% names(Candidates)) {Candidates$lon <- get_lonlat(Candidates)$x}
                                                                if (!"lat" %in% names(Candidates)) {Candidates$lat <- get_lonlat(Candidates)$y}
                                                                
                                                                Selected <- Candidates[0, ]
                                                                
                                                                if (!".threshold" %in% names(Selected)) {Selected$.threshold <- character(0)}
                                                                if (!".selection_order" %in% names(Selected)) {Selected$.selection_order <- integer(0)}
                                                                
                                                                Selection_log <- tibble::tibble()
                                                                sampled_augmented <- Sampled %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geometry) %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::mutate(ID = dplyr::row_number())
                                                                
                                                                Countries <- sort(unique(Candidates$geo_admin0))
                                                                Countries <- Countries[!is.na(Countries)]
                                                                
                                                                for (Country in Countries) {message("Processing ", threshold_name, " / ", Country)
                                                                                            remaining <- Candidates %>%
                                                                                                         dplyr::filter(geo_admin0 == Country)
                                                                                            
                                                                                            if (nrow(remaining) == 0) {next}
                                                                                            
                                                                                            remaining_xy <- get_lonlat(remaining)
                                                                                            remaining <- remaining[!duplicated(paste(round(remaining_xy$x, 6),
                                                                                                                                     round(remaining_xy$y, 6),
                                                                                                                                     sep = "_")),]
                                                                                            
                                                                                            if (nrow(remaining) == 0) {next}
                                                                                            
                                                                                            selected_country <- remaining[0, ]
                                                                                            n_selected <- 0L
                                                                                            
                                                                                            while (nrow(remaining) > 0 && n_selected < n_sites_per_country) {sampled_country <- sampled_augmented %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                dplyr::filter(geo_admin0 == Country)
                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                             existing <- sampled_country %>%
                                                                                                                                                                         dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geometry)
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             n_needed <- n_sites_per_country - n_selected
                                                                                                                                                             chosen_ids <- choose_candidate_batch_cover(remaining = remaining,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        existing = existing,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        n_choose = n_needed,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        nruns = nruns)
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             chosen_ids <- unique(chosen_ids)
                                                                                                                                                             chosen_ids <- chosen_ids[is.finite(chosen_ids) & chosen_ids >= 1 & chosen_ids <= nrow(remaining)]
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             if (length(chosen_ids) == 0) {break}
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             accepted_ids <- integer(0)
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             for (chosen_i in chosen_ids) {chosen_site <- remaining[chosen_i, , drop = FALSE]
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             violates_existing <- FALSE
                                                                                                                                                             violates_selected <- FALSE
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             # Check against original sampled sites and accepted sites from previous batches, because sampled_augmented is updated after each accepted site.
                                                                                                                                                             if (nrow(existing) > 0) {d_existing <- geodist_matrix_m(A = chosen_site,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     B = existing,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                     measure = geodist_measure)
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                      violates_existing <- any(as.numeric(d_existing) < min_distance_m, na.rm = TRUE)}
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             # Check against sites accepted in this country for this threshold, including sites accepted earlier in the same batch.
                                                                                                                                                             if (nrow(selected_country) > 0) {d_selected <- geodist_matrix_m(A = chosen_site,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             B = selected_country,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                             measure = geodist_measure)
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                              violates_selected <- any(as.numeric(d_selected) < min_distance_m, na.rm = TRUE)}
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             if (violates_existing || violates_selected) {next}
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             n_selected <- n_selected + 1L
                                                                                                                                                             chosen_site$.threshold <- threshold_name
                                                                                                                                                             chosen_site$.selection_order <- n_selected
                                                                                                                                                             chosen_site$lon <- get_lonlat(chosen_site)$x
                                                                                                                                                             chosen_site$lat <- get_lonlat(chosen_site)$y
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             selected_country <- dplyr::bind_rows(selected_country, chosen_site)
                                                                                                                                                             Selected <- dplyr::bind_rows(Selected, chosen_site)
                                                                                                                                                             sampled_augmented <- dplyr::bind_rows(sampled_augmented %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                                   dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geometry),
                                                                                                                                                                                                   chosen_site %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                                   dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geometry)) %>%
                                                                                                                                                                                  dplyr::mutate(ID = dplyr::row_number())
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             Selection_log <- dplyr::bind_rows(Selection_log,
                                                                                                                                                                                               tibble::tibble(Threshold = threshold_name,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              geo_admin0 = Country,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              selection_order = n_selected,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              lon = chosen_site$lon,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              lat = chosen_site$lat,
                                                                                                                                                                                                              remaining_before_radius_removal = nrow(remaining)))
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             accepted_ids <- c(accepted_ids, chosen_i)
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             if (n_selected >= n_sites_per_country) {break}}
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             # Remove all candidates proposed by this batch.
                                                                                                                                                             remaining <- remaining[-chosen_ids, , drop = FALSE]
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             if (nrow(remaining) == 0) {break}
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             # Remove all still-remaining candidates within 50 km of any accepted site for this country and threshold.
                                                                                                                                                             if (nrow(selected_country) > 0) {d_to_selected <- geodist_matrix_m(A = remaining,
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                B = selected_country, 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                measure = geodist_measure)
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             keep_far_enough <- apply(d_to_selected,
                                                                                                                                                                                      1,
                                                                                                                                                                                      function(x) {all(as.numeric(x) >= min_distance_m, na.rm = TRUE)})
                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                             remaining <- remaining[keep_far_enough,, drop = FALSE]}}
                                                                                            
                                                                                            message("Selected ", nrow(selected_country), " for ", Country)}
                                                                
                                                                if (nrow(Selected) > 0) {Selected$lon <- get_lonlat(Selected)$x
                                                                                         Selected$lat <- get_lonlat(Selected)$y}
                                                                
                                                                list(Sites = Selected,
                                                                     Sampled_augmented = sampled_augmented,
                                                                     Selection_log = Selection_log)}

make_point_type_legend <- function(show_text = TRUE) {if (!isTRUE(show_text)) return(NULL)
                                                      htmltools::HTML(paste0('<div style="
                                                                              background:rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
                                                                              padding:8px 10px;
                                                                              border-radius:6px;
                                                                              font-family:\'Times New Roman\', Times, serif !important;
                                                                              font-size:10pt !important;
                                                                              color:black !important;
                                                                              ">
                                                                              <div class="legend-title" style="
                                                                              text-align:center;
                                                                              font-weight:bold !important;
                                                                              margin-bottom:6px;
                                                                              ">Point type</div>
                                                                              <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;">
                                                                              <span style="
                                                                              display:inline-block;
                                                                              width:10px;
                                                                              height:10px;
                                                                              border-radius:50%;
                                                                              background:orange;
                                                                              border:1px solid white;
                                                                              margin-right:6px;
                                                                              "></span>
                                                                              <span>Sampled locations</span>
                                                                              </div>
                                                                              <div style="display:flex; align-items:center;">
                                                                              <span style="
                                                                              display:inline-block;
                                                                              width:10px;
                                                                              height:10px;
                                                                              border-radius:50%;
                                                                              background:#BE1D54;
                                                                              border:1px solid white;
                                                                              margin-right:6px;
                                                                              "></span>
                                                                              <span>Proposed locations</span>
                                                                              </div>
                                                                             </div>'))}

make_sampled_selected_overlay_map <- function(show_text = TRUE) {legend_html <- make_uncertainty_legend(show_text = show_text)
                                                                 point_legend <- make_point_type_legend(show_text = show_text)
                                                                 
                                                                 Sampled_map <- Sampled %>%
                                                                                sf::st_transform(4326) %>%
                                                                                dplyr::mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
                                                                                              lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 2])
                                                                 
                                                                 Selected_map <- Selected_sites %>%
                                                                                 sf::st_transform(4326) %>%
                                                                                 dplyr::mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
                                                                                               lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 2])
                                                                 
                                                                 map <- leaflet::leaflet(width = 1500,
                                                                                         height = 750,
                                                                                         options = leaflet::leafletOptions(minzoom = 2,
                                                                                                                           worldCopyJump = FALSE)) %>%
                                                                        leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron",
                                                                                                  options = leaflet::providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
                                                                        leaflet::addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%
                                                                        leaflet::setView(lng = 70, lat = 30, zoom = 4) %>%
                                                                        leaflet::addRasterImage(Uncertainty, colors = Pal, opacity = 0.8) %>%
                                                                        leaflet::addPolygons(data = ADM0Polygon,
                                                                                             color = "black",
                                                                                             weight = 1.5,
                                                                                             smoothFactor = 1,
                                                                                             fillColor = "transparent",
                                                                                             opacity = 1) %>%
                                                                        leaflet::addCircleMarkers(data = Sampled_map,
                                                                                                  radius = 5,
                                                                                                  fillColor = "orange",
                                                                                                  color = "white",
                                                                                                  weight = 1,
                                                                                                  stroke = TRUE,
                                                                                                  fillOpacity = 0.95,
                                                                                                  popup = ~paste0("<strong>Sampled location</strong>",
                                                                                                                  "<br><strong>Country:</strong> ", geo_admin0,
                                                                                                                  "<br><strong>Coordinates:</strong> (",
                                                                                                                  round(lat, 4), ", ", round(lon, 4), ")")) %>%
                                                                        leaflet::addCircleMarkers(data = Selected_map,
                                                                                                  radius = 5,
                                                                                                  fillColor = "#BE1D54",
                                                                                                  color = "white",
                                                                                                  weight = 1,
                                                                                                  stroke = TRUE,
                                                                                                  fillOpacity = 0.95,
                                                                                                  popup = ~paste0("<strong>Selected location</strong>",
                                                                                                                  "<br><strong>Country:</strong> ", geo_admin0,
                                                                                                                  "<br><strong>Population:</strong> ", format(round(Population, 0), big.mark = ","),
                                                                                                                  "<br><strong>Uncertainty (95% CI):</strong> ", round(Uncertainty, 2),
                                                                                                                  "<br><strong>Coordinates:</strong> (",
                                                                                                                  round(lat, 4), ", ", round(lon, 4), ")")) %>%
                                                                        leaflet::addControl(html = legend_html, position = "bottomleft")
                                                                 
                                                                 if (!is.null(point_legend)) {map <- map %>%
                                                                                                     leaflet::addControl(html = point_legend, position = "bottomleft")}
                                                                 map}

Map_Sampled_Selected <- make_sampled_selected_overlay_map(show_text = TRUE)
```

# Vizualize aggregated burden
```{r aggregate}
make_admin_burden_map <- function(admin_vector,
                                  admin_level,
                                  pal,
                                  show_text = TRUE,
                                  title = "Estimated number of β-thalassaemia carriers") {admin_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(admin_vector)
                                                                                          value_values <- admin_sf$mean
                                                                                          value_values <- value_values[is.finite(value_values)]
                                                                                          legend_html <- make_horizontal_colourbar_legend(pal = pal,
                                                                                                                                          values = value_values,
                                                                                                                                          title = title,
                                                                                                                                          show_text = show_text,
                                                                                                                                          accuracy = 1,
                                                                                                                                          comma_labels = TRUE)
                                                                                          
                                                                                          popup_col <- dplyr::case_when(admin_level == "ADM0" ~ "geo_admin0",
                                                                                                                        admin_level == "ADM1" ~ "geo_admin1",
                                                                                                                        admin_level == "ADM2" ~ "geo_admin2",
                                                                                                                        TRUE ~ "geo_admin0")
                                                                                          
                                                                                          leaflet::leaflet(admin_sf,
                                                                                                           width = 1500,
                                                                                                           height = 750,
                                                                                                           options = leaflet::leafletOptions(minZoom = 2,
                                                                                                                                             worldCopyJump = FALSE)) %>%
                                                                                          leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron",
                                                                                                                    options = leaflet::providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
                                                                                          leaflet::addScaleBar(position = c("bottomleft")) %>%
                                                                                          leaflet::setView(lng = 70, lat = 30, zoom = 4) %>%
                                                                                          leaflet::addPolygons(color = ~ pal(mean),
                                                                                                               weight = 1.5,
                                                                                                               smoothFactor = 1,
                                                                                                               opacity = 0.8,
                                                                                                               fillOpacity = 0.8,
                                                                                                               popup = ~ paste0("<b>", admin_level, ":</b> ", get(popup_col),
                                                                                                                                "<br><b>Estimated carriers:</b> ", scales::comma(round(mean, 0)),
                                                                                                                                "<br><b>Lower estimate:</b> ", scales::comma(round(l, 0)),
                                                                                                                                "<br><b>Upper estimate:</b> ", scales::comma(round(u, 0)),
                                                                                                                                "<br><b>Mean prevalence (%):</b> ", round(pmean, 2),
                                                                                                                                "<br><b>95% CI width (%):</b> ", round(ci95, 2))) %>%
                                                                                          leaflet::addControl(html = legend_html,
                                                                                                              position = "bottomleft")}

export_admin_raster_csv <- function(vector_object,
                                    admin_level,
                                    output_file,
                                    value_cols = c("mean", "l", "u",
                                                   "pmean", "ci95", "pu", "pl", "psd")) {df <- terra::as.data.frame(vector_object)
                                                                                         keep_cols <- intersect(c("geo_admin0",
                                                                                                                  "geo_admin1",
                                                                                                                  "geo_admin2",
                                                                                                                  "name",
                                                                                                                  value_cols),
                                                                                                                names(df))
                                                                                         
                                                                                         df_out <- df %>%
                                                                                                   dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(keep_cols)) %>%
                                                                                                   dplyr::mutate(admin_level = admin_level) %>%
                                                                                                   dplyr::relocate(admin_level) %>%
                                                                                                   dplyr::arrange(dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of(c("geo_admin0", "geo_admin1", "geo_admin2")))) %>%
                                                                                                   distinct()
                                                                                         
                                                                                         readr::write_csv(df_out, output_file)
                                                                                         invisible(df_out)}

ADM2_PSD <- extract(Selected_INLA_Result$PredictionSD, ADM2_vector, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

ADM2_vector$mean <- ADM2_PredictionMean[[2]]
ADM2_vector$l <- ADM2_PredictionL[[2]]
ADM2_vector$u <- ADM2_PredictionU[[2]]
ADM2_vector$pmean <- ADM2_PMean[[2]]
ADM2_vector$ci95 <- ADM2_95CI[[2]]
ADM2_vector$pu <- ADM2_PU[[2]]
ADM2_vector$pl <- ADM2_PL[[2]]
ADM2_vector$psd <- ADM2_PSD[[2]]

ADM2_csv <- export_admin_raster_csv(vector_object = ADM2_vector,
                                    admin_level = "ADM2",
                                    output_file = file.path("Output/Final4/", "ADM2_raster_values.csv"))

ADM2_vector <- ADM2_vector[!is.na(ADM2_vector$mean), ]

ADM2_PredictionMean_Pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric(reverse = TRUE,
                                                 na.color = "transparent",
                                                 palette = viridis::viridis_pal(option = "F", end = 0.9)(10),
                                                 domain = c(min(ADM2_vector$mean, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                            max(ADM2_vector$mean, na.rm = TRUE)))

ADM2_Mean <- make_admin_burden_map(admin_vector = ADM2_vector,
                                   admin_level = "ADM2",
                                   pal = ADM2_PredictionMean_Pal,
                                   show_text = TRUE,
                                   title = legend_titles$burden)

ADM2_Mean2 <- make_admin_burden_map(admin_vector = ADM2_vector,
                                    admin_level = "ADM2",
                                    pal = ADM2_PredictionMean_Pal,
                                    show_text = FALSE,
                                    title = legend_titles$burden)

export_leaflet_tiff(widget = ADM2_Mean,
                    output_file = "Output/Final4/ADM2_Burden_with_text.tiff",
                    selfcontained = FALSE)

export_leaflet_tiff(widget = ADM2_Mean2,
                    output_file = "Output/Final4/ADM2_Burden_no_text.tiff",
                    selfcontained = FALSE)

ADM2_Burden_raster <- terra::rasterize(terra::project(ADM2_vector, terra::crs(Selected_INLA_Result$Burden)),
                                       Selected_INLA_Result$Burden,
                                       field = "mean",
                                       touches = TRUE,
                                       background = NA)

terra::writeRaster(ADM2_Burden_raster,
                   filename = "Output/Final4/ADM2_Burden.tiff",
                   overwrite = TRUE)

# Add admin names to exported raster-value CSVs
process_admin_raster_csv_names <- function(output_dir) {adm0_file <- file.path(output_dir, "ADM0_raster_values.csv")
                                                        adm1_file <- file.path(output_dir, "ADM1_raster_values.csv")
                                                        adm2_file <- file.path(output_dir, "ADM2_raster_values.csv")
                                                        
                                                        adm0 <- readr::read_csv(adm0_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
                                                        adm1 <- readr::read_csv(adm1_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
                                                        adm2 <- readr::read_csv(adm2_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
                                                        
                                                        adm0_lookup <- adm0 %>%
                                                                       dplyr::select(geo_admin0,
                                                                                     adm0 = name) %>%
                                                                       dplyr::distinct()
                                                        
                                                        adm1_lookup <- adm1 %>%
                                                                       dplyr::select(geo_admin0,
                                                                                     geo_admin1,    
                                                                                     adm1 = name) %>%
                                                                       dplyr::distinct()
                                                        
                                                        adm1_out <- adm1 %>%
                                                                    dplyr::left_join(adm0_lookup, by = "geo_admin0") %>%
                                                                    dplyr::relocate(adm0, .after = geo_admin0)
                                                        
                                                        adm2_out <- adm2 %>%
                                                                    dplyr::left_join(adm0_lookup, by = "geo_admin0") %>%
                                                                    dplyr::left_join(adm1_lookup, by = c("geo_admin0", "geo_admin1")) %>%
                                                                    dplyr::relocate(adm0, .after = geo_admin0) %>%
                                                                    dplyr::relocate(adm1, .after = geo_admin1)
                                                        
                                                        readr::write_csv(adm0, adm0_file)
                                                        readr::write_csv(adm1_out, adm1_file)
                                                        readr::write_csv(adm2_out, adm2_file)
                                                        
                                                        invisible(list(ADM0 = adm0,
                                                                       ADM1 = adm1_out,
                                                                       ADM2 = adm2_out))}

admin_csvs <- process_admin_raster_csv_names(output_dir = "Output/Final4/")
```

# Export
```{r export sites csv}
gpkg_dir <- "Input"

ADM0_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM0.gpkg")
ADM1_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM1.gpkg")
ADM2_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM2.gpkg")

ADM0_shapes <- sf::st_read(ADM0_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(geo_admin0, name, geom) %>%
               dplyr::rename(adm0 = name,
                             geo0 = geom)

sf::st_geometry(ADM0_shapes) <- "geo0"

ADM1_shapes <- sf::st_read(ADM1_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geo_admin1, name, geom) %>%
               dplyr::rename(adm1 = name,
                             geo1 = geom)

sf::st_geometry(ADM1_shapes) <- "geo1"

ADM2_shapes <- sf::st_read(ADM2_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(geo_admin0, geo_admin2, name, geom) %>%
               dplyr::rename(adm2 = name,
                             geo2 = geom)

sf::st_geometry(ADM2_shapes) <- "geo2"

add_admin_names_to_sites <- function(site_df,
                                     ADM0_shapes,
                                     ADM1_shapes,
                                     ADM2_shapes,
                                     lon_col = "lon",
                                     lat_col = "lat",
                                     crs_lonlat = 4326) {old_s2 <- sf::sf_use_s2()
                                                         sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
                                                         on.exit(sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE), add = TRUE)
                                                         
                                                         if (!all(c(lon_col, lat_col) %in% names(site_df))) {stop("Coordinate columns not found. Available columns are: ", paste(names(site_df), collapse = ", "))}
                                                         
                                                         ADM0_shapes <- sf::st_as_sf(ADM0_shapes)
                                                         ADM1_shapes <- sf::st_as_sf(ADM1_shapes)
                                                         ADM2_shapes <- sf::st_as_sf(ADM2_shapes)
                                                         
                                                         if ("geo0" %in% names(ADM0_shapes)) {sf::st_geometry(ADM0_shapes) <- "geo0"}
                                                         if ("geo1" %in% names(ADM1_shapes)) {sf::st_geometry(ADM1_shapes) <- "geo1"}
                                                         if ("geo2" %in% names(ADM2_shapes)) {sf::st_geometry(ADM2_shapes) <- "geo2"}
                                                         
                                                         site_sf <- site_df %>%
                                                                    dplyr::mutate(site_id = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
                                                                    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c(lon_col, lat_col),
                                                                                 crs = crs_lonlat,
                                                                                 remove = FALSE)
                                                         
                                                         ADM0_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM0_shapes, sf::st_crs(site_sf))
                                                         ADM1_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM1_shapes, sf::st_crs(site_sf))
                                                         ADM2_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM2_shapes, sf::st_crs(site_sf))
                                                         
                                                         adm0_lookup <- ADM0_shapes %>%
                                                                        dplyr::select(adm0_geo_admin0 = geo_admin0, adm0)
                                                         
                                                         adm1_lookup <- ADM1_shapes %>%
                                                                        dplyr::select(adm1_geo_admin0 = geo_admin0, 
                                                                                      adm1_geo_admin1 = geo_admin1, adm1)
                                                         
                                                         adm2_lookup <- ADM2_shapes %>%
                                                                        dplyr::select(adm2_geo_admin0 = geo_admin0,
                                                                                      adm2_geo_admin2 = geo_admin2, adm2)
                                                         
                                                         out_sf <- site_sf %>%
                                                                   sf::st_join(adm0_lookup, join = sf::st_within, left = TRUE) %>%
                                                                   sf::st_join(adm1_lookup, join = sf::st_within, left = TRUE) %>%
                                                                   sf::st_join(adm2_lookup, join = sf::st_within, left = TRUE)
                                                         
                                                         out <- out_sf %>%   
                                                                sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                                dplyr::mutate(geo_admin0 = dplyr::coalesce(adm0_geo_admin0,
                                                                                                           adm1_geo_admin0,
                                                                                                           adm2_geo_admin0),
                                                                              geo_admin1 = adm1_geo_admin1,
                                                                              geo_admin2 = adm2_geo_admin2) %>%
                                                                dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("adm0_geo_admin0",
                                                                                               "adm1_geo_admin0",
                                                                                               "adm2_geo_admin0",
                                                                                               "adm1_geo_admin1",
                                                                                               "adm2_geo_admin2"))) %>%
                                                                dplyr::relocate(site_id, dplyr::all_of(lon_col), dplyr::all_of(lat_col), geo_admin0, adm0, geo_admin1, adm1, geo_admin2, adm2)
                                                         out}

readr::write_csv(add_admin_names_to_sites(site_df = Selected_sites,
                                           ADM0_shapes = ADM0_shapes,
                                           ADM1_shapes = ADM1_shapes,
                                           ADM2_shapes = ADM2_shapes,
                                           lon_col = "lon",
                                           lat_col = "lat") %>% 
                                           dplyr::distinct(),
                  file.path(output_dir, paste0("Selected-sites-Final_coordinates_admin_names.csv")))
```
